title: Red, White & Bonobo Blue
author: Susan Block
content:
[![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/06/Pan_paniscus11-680x456.jpg)](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/06/19/red-
white-bonobo-blue/)

![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/06/Pan_paniscus11-680x456.jpg)

A Group of bonobos. Photo: [Pierre Fidenci](http://calphotos.berkeley.edu).
[CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5)

We’re just a few [sparklers](https://drsusanblock.com/fireworks-sex) and a
sucker punch away from America’s 250th birthday. It’s times like these that I
really miss my dearly departed [Captain
Max](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/05/28/the-ballad-of-captain-max/) –
both to celebrate the red, white and
[bonobo](https://blockbonobofoundation.org/) blue and to stand with me against
these performative patriots with sucker-punching
[kinks](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/kink). But my beloved
[Max](https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/06/20/captain-max-an-extraordinary-
life/), aka Pr. [Maximillian Lobkowicz di
Filangieri](https://drsusanblock.com/max-lobkowicz-filangieri-obituary)
(November 8, 1943 – May 13, 2025), is [gone](https://drsusanblock.com/rip-
max), so what’s a [weeping
widow](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/04/10/a-widows-wedding-anniversary/)
to do with her summertime red, white and blues?

_No_[ _Erika Kirk_](https://drsusanblock.com/max-collage-stroke-
death#ErikaKirk) _prayers please!_

Perhaps it’s because, even after over [a
year](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/05/01/stroke-unto-death-maxs-last-
year-a-year-later/), I’m still [grieving](https://drsusanblock.com/bottomless-
grief). Or maybe just watching the [UFC Freedom
250](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2026/06/14/trump-white-
house-fight-updates--live/90509666007/) American
[Tsar](https://drsusanblock.com/tag/trump) and his casually
[abusive](https://drsusanblock.com/active-radio-6),
[homophobic](https://www.espn.com/mma/story/_/id/49074842/josh-hokit-
disparages-michelle-obama-ufc-white-house-
event)-yet-[homoerotic](https://www.reddit.com/r/Showerthoughts/comments/9vwc8o/wwe_is_just_gay_porn_with_no_sex/),
[war](https://drsusanblock.com/max-collage-easter-passover-nowruz)-blundering,
[tRump](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/anal)-glazing,
[crypto](https://www.indy100.com/politics/trump/trump-crypto-ufc-
freedom-250-world-liberty-financial)-slurping courtiers [come
out](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/man-2-man)
[swinging](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/group),
[spitting](https://www.instagram.com/reels/DZiDGwsONTN/) and waving the flag –
getting the summer party started by trashing the White House lawn – makes me
want to [spit up](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7361678/2026/06/15/ufc-
white-house-trump-scene/) a little too.

Is brandishing the flag always so bad? Unfortunately, and usually, yes.
Especially nowadays when waving the Old Glory is a *red flag* that signals the
waver to be a [performing](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/erotic-theater)
member of the extended [Trump Family](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-trump-
nukes) [Circus](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-coup-anon) of
[Marks](https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/02/28/fight-the-billionaire-mind-
virus/) and [Grifters](https://drsusanblock.com/post-trump-sex-disorder) – the
suckers and sucker punchers.

But it wasn’t always that way, not in
[Bonoboville](https://drsusanblock.com/bonoboville) where my beloved Max and I
celebrated what we then saw as our sacred American freedoms enshrined in our
Bill of Rights, all decked out in romantic red, angelic white and
[bonobo](https://bonoboway.com/) blue – with extra
[sparkles](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-freedom-restraint%20%E2%80%8E) on the
[4th of July](https://drsusanblock.com/wp-
content/uploads/2017/06/Fireworks_July4th_DrSuzy-Tv_c.jpg).

This numerically auspicious Fourth, my [widow](https://drsusanblock.com/max-
collage-anniversaries)’s
[grief](https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/09/05/bottomless-grief-topless-
cake/) [therapy](https://drsusanblock.com/max-collage-family) has me
[roleplaying](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/fantasy-roleplay) [Betsy
Ross](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Betsy_Ross), stitching together a new [Max
Collage](https://drsusanblock.com/max-collage-red-white-blue) of American
flags and [fireworks](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-fireworks), [free
speech](https://drsusanblock.com/free-speech-woman) and [free
love](https://drsusanblock.com/free-love). A war refugee,
[Max](https://drsusanblock.com/max-ballad) cherished the stars and stripes for
their twinkling promise of freedom from the devastating war into which he was
[born](https://drsusanblock.com/max-ballad). When he turned 18, he even
enlisted, proving himself to be a crack shot, until he realized that meant
killing people, as opposed to just targets. This was not Max’s idea of
freedom. So, he pretended to go mad – or maybe the realization _drove_ him
mad. He threatened to reveal his superior’s secrets, promptly receiving an
honorable discharge… and his freedom.

Then Max found his Great Love. No, not me (that came later)… publishing. His
“reader-written” magazines – _The_[ _L.A.
Star_](https://drsusanblock.com/max.html) (with Paul and Shirley Eberle)
[_Love Magazine_](https://drsusanblock.com/wp-
content/uploads/2019/11/MG_5659.jpg) (with [Willem de
Ridder](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-willem-de-ridder)), [_Hate
Magazine_](https://drsusanblock.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/HATE-MAG.jpg)
_,_[_Finger_](https://drsusanblock.com/saga-finger-magazine)
[_Magazine_](https://drsusanblock.com/wp-
content/uploads/2019/07/IMG_20190702_152321.jpg)
_,_[_God_](https://drsusanblock.com/wp-
content/uploads/2019/11/20191109radiosuzyJux084.jpg) _, Charles Gatewood’s_[
_Forbidden Photographs_](https://www.abebooks.com/book-search/title/forbidden-
photographs/author/gatewood-charles/) _,_[_Annie
Sprinkle_](https://drsusanblock.tv/show/sets.php?id=695) _’s_[
_Sprinkle_](https://drsusanblock.tv/show/sets.php?id=695) _Report,_[_The
Brentwood Bla Bla_](https://drsusanblock.com/tag/the-brentwood-bla-bla-
magazine) _,_[_Beverly Hills the Magazine_](https://drsusanblock.com/prince-
bear) _,_[_Meetings with Remarkable
People_](https://www.beatbooks.com/pages/books/39962/dreksler-lobkowicz-
brothers-presents-meetings-with-remarkable-people-number-one-los-angeles-ca)
_,_[_Speakeasy Magazine_](https://drsusanblock.com/speakeasy) and many more –
prefigured social media and tested the limits of the First Amendment. Of
course, the same flag that promised him free speech shut him up from time to
time, but never shut him down. Not even in death, as here I am, still telling
tales of [Max](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/05/28/the-ballad-of-captain-
max/)…

**“Public Happiness”**

Fun factoid: two of America’s Founding Fathers, Benjamin Franklin and Thomas
Jefferson, gained ideological inspiration for the U.S. Constitution and
perhaps the Declaration of Independence from their Italian pen pal,
progressive Enlightenment philosopher [Gaetano
Filangieri](https://drsusanblock.com/max-to-the-maximus-memorial#Filangieri)
(22 August 1753 – 21 July 1788) who happened to have been
[Max](http://www.drsusanblock.tv/main/sets.php?id=173)‘s great great great
great great grandfather on his mother’s side.

The 5th Prince of Satriano, Filangieri championed such radical ideas as
personal liberty, equality and “[public
happiness](https://calandrainstitute.org/events/from-naples-to-america-
enlightening-correspondences-and-the-pursuit-of-happiness/).” Author of one of
the most important works of the Enlightenment, [_The Science of
Legislation_](https://www.britannica.com/topic/The-Science-of-Legislation),
Filangieri corresponded with Franklin, and Jefferson praised Filangieri after
his untimely death in a letter to Max’s great great great great grandmother,
[Charlotte Frendel
Filangieri](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gaetano_Filangieri,_5th_Prince_of_Satriano),
Gaetano’s beloved widow.

You could say that the “[pursuit of
happiness](https://constitutioncenter.org/essays/the-pursuit-of-happiness)” –
including Filangieri’s “public happiness” with a
pro-[bonobo](http://amzn.to/1zimlbP) twist – flowed through Max’s DNA, but it
wasn’t about bloodlines. The pursuit of public happiness – having fun while
doing good (or at least not hurting anyone) – spread through
[Bonoboville](https://drsusanblock.com/bonoboville). We waved our flags for
freedom, including our personal sexual freedom – even if that meant being free
to be [restrained](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/bondage), chained and
whipped like a slave – in public! Freedom is the greatest aphrodisiac – but
restraint is a close second. Consenting adults only, of course (we’re the
Block Institute, not the [Epstein Class](https://drsusanblock.com/active-
radio-6)).

**One**[DrSuzy-
Tv](https://drsusanblock.tv/)**show**[favorite](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/kink)**was**[spanking](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/spanking)**a**
[Trump](https://drsusanblock.com/tag/trump) impersonator with an American
flagpole. Nowadays, you might call this sort of _Commedia Americana_ a
“limited hangout” or “controlled opposition,” though we called it
[bacchanalian](https://drsusanblock.com/lupercalia-2018)
pro-[bonobo](https://www.amazon.com/Bonobo-Way-Evolution-through-Pleasure-
ebook/dp/B00ODR23WE/) [resistance](https://drsusanblock.com/electoral-
dysfunction). But little by little and then by a lot, our freedom of speech
was more nonconsensually restrained, our [Facebook,
Instagram](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-banned-on-facebook) and
[YouTube](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-youtube-censors) channels deactivated
without warning, and our community under [attack](https://drsusanblock.com/go-
bonobos-2026#attack), like so many [sex
educator](https://drsusanblock.com/kinsey)s,
[Palestine](https://www.counterpunch.org/2024/05/17/reply-to-a-zionist-troll/)
supporters and [antiwar](https://www.counterpunch.org/2022/10/06/make-kink-
not-war/) activists on the Left and Right.

As I [grieve](https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/09/05/bottomless-grief-
topless-cake/), I wonder how [Max](https://drsusanblock.com/max-ballad) would
bear witness to the current uptick in fascism, war, genocide, AI, lies,
[puritanical](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/02/20/the-state-of-sexual-
union-2026/) [censorship](https://drsusanblock.com/billionaire-mind-virus) and
hypocrisy, the suckers and [sucker
punchers](https://www.reddit.com/r/DiveInYouCoward/comments/1u6hm2s/ufc_freedom_250_at_the_white_house_turns_into_a/).
I’m sure he’d speak his mind, as he always encouraged me to do, while waving
the flag – with fireworks, also an
[aphrodisiac](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/kink) – sparkling
[foreplay](https://drsusanblock.com/7-things-about-foreplay-sexperts-really-
want-you-to-know-she-knows),
[orgasms](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/orgasm) for the
[eye](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/voyeur) on the [4th of
July](https://drsusanblock.com/july-4th%20%E2%80%8E).

Unfortunately, most freedom-affirming pyrotechnics are neither ecologically
friendly nor safe. Pro-Tip: Don’t set off your fireworks by hand, or you could
lose your fingers – and how are you going to
[finger](https://archive.drsusanblock.com/Ccbilltheater/foreplay.htm) someone
with no fingers?

Sparklers do the trick. For America’s 250th birthday, I raise a sparkler to
Captain Max, to “public happiness,” free speech, free love and the general
all-around red, white and [bonobo](https://drsusanblock.com/go-
bonobos-2026)-blue freedom for which he stood.

Amen. Awomen. Goddess bless America.
